notes: The two remaining groups are real, not a connectivity error. The booklet builds two separate models, each numbered from step 1: the crook's swamp hideout (pages 3-9, pieces b1-b13) and the police ATV (pages 10-21, pieces b14-b50). No step joins them, so I did not invent a connection between them.
Parts list totals 50 pieces; minifigure parts (torsos, heads, hats, legs, backpack, sack) are not in the list so they are not recorded.

The banknote tiles b1/b2 are joined to each other, and to the hideout slope b6 because page 9 shows them in the sack there. The bar holder group b48-b50 is joined to the ATV through the bar 3L b49, clipped in the rear clip b21 in step 14. The snake b50 hangs on the bar holder.
Page 4: the wedge plate b5 is assumed to sit on top of the front row of the 2x4 plate b3. The overlap is ambiguous in the booklet.
Page 5: the exact studs for the two 1x2 plates, the handle tile and the lime round plate on the log b4 are guessed. The log's four studs are shared as b8 (1 stud, with the slope), b9 (2), b11 (1).
b12 is clipped to the handle of b10. The plant b13 is recorded as held in b12's clip, since the booklet doesn't show how it attaches. It tilts up on page 9.
Wheel plates b15/b16 attach under the 2x6 brick b14 (step 2). Their studs go into the brick's bottom, so I recorded this as an other_join and left rests_on empty.
Page 12-13: the four white clip plates are assumed to form two stacks of two on the rear mudguard b18. The grille tile b23 is recorded as held by their clips.
Page 14: the yellow handle tile b24 is a studless tile that clutches studs, so I assumed it rests on the mudguard b18.
Page 18: the black clip plate b36 is assumed to clip onto the grey side-handle plate b31 at the front. The two trans-yellow round plates are its headlights.
Taps b25/b26 are plugged into the handle of the yellow tile. Each carries a trans-blue round plate (spout side) and a trans-red round tile (back).
Step 14 shows the bar 3L at the vehicle's rear, but the booklet doesn't say which clip holds it, so b21 is a guess. On page 21 the minifigure holds it with the snake.

Page 12-13: the four white clip plates are assumed to form two stacks of two on the rear mudguard b18. The grille tile b23 is recorded as held by their clips.

Page 18: the black clip plate b36 is assumed to clip onto the grey side-handle plate b31 at the front. The two trans-yellow round plates are its headlights.
